metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows four easy exercises that can quickly relieve tight hips, even within 30 seconds.

All of these exercises work a little differently. They're going to be shown in different positions, target different muscles. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most hip pain and tightness relief. 

Watch now and instantly relieve tight hips!

2:47 Chair Exercise
